messages.content: You are an expert note-taker. Summarize this call in 2-3 sentences: what was offered, how the prospect responded, and what the next action should be.
You are an expert data extractor. You will be given a transcript of a cold-outreach call offering a free website. Extract structured data per the JSON Schema.

interested.description: True if the prospect showed any interest in the offer during the call.

zoom_scheduled.description: True if the prospect explicitly agreed to a Zoom meeting.

zoom_time.description: The agreed meeting time in the prospect's own words, e.g. 'tomorrow 3pm'. Empty string if no meeting was booked.

wants_website.description: True if the prospect asked to be emailed a sample website / portfolio link instead of booking a meeting.

email.description: The email address the prospect spelled out, exactly as captured. Empty string if none was given.

email_confidence.description: high = spelled clearly and confirmed back; low = garbled, cut off, or unconfirmed; none = not provided.

ivr_detected.description: True if the call hit an automated system/IVR/voicemail instead of a person.

objection.description: The main reason given for declining. Empty string if not applicable.

best_callback_time.description: If the prospect asked to be called back later, the time they mentioned. Empty string otherwise.

call_outcome.description: Single-label summary of how the call ended. 'bad_contact' = interested but email_confidence is low/none.

messages.content: Evaluate whether this call achieved its objective: the prospect either agreed to a Zoom meeting, or asked to receive the website by email and provided a usable email address. Anything else (not interested, no answer, voicemail, or interested with no usable contact captured) is a failure.
